body:
```

Build type: RelWithDebInfo

```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/d714648b8e7c476b7b5c1f661aa192b179bfc1d3) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: Hermes Agent v0.22.5
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.5

**Release Date:** October 22, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~81 PRs merged since v0.22.4 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `bf0203a794a`, the window since v0.22.4 contains **231 non-merge commits** across **804 changed files** (+35,212 / −17,885), **81 merged PRs** and **30 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: Nous sign-in reworked (every sign-in is the plain device login, the free-tier guest hands over to your account, the result shows who signed in, connectors offer sign-in instead of opening a guest), `hermes update` holding back a stable release it refuses instead of offering it, Windows `hermes update` no longer stuck on the old launcher after a Python repin, usage-window plan support (plan gauges, limit cards and model-switch recovery for window-based plans), pluggable delegation backends (route subagents by model map or profile, switchable per session), plugin slash commands that can ask you to pick an option, `hermes import-agent`, OpenClaw migration, `hermes mcp serve` and the Singularity backend moving out of core into plugins (setup offers the importer when it finds another agent), Desktop drag-to-pin in the sidebar and one-click plugin installs with tier badges, the Electron 44 upgrade, Pillow 13 and a batch of dependency security bumps, a clear message when a chat's working folder is gone, `hermes update` recovering paused gateways after a damaged `.git`, long Claude DirectSDK answers no longer cut off by the stall timer, Desktop group chats showing which bot is working again, and the experimental webhook-mode MCP events client.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.4...v0.22.5](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.4...v0.22.5)

name: v0.8.188
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.188

Released on 2026-10-23.

Lambda cloud renders now run their video work on arm64 by default, which costs less per render. Pass --video-arch x86_64 to keep x86.

This release also fixes renders in folders with a percent sign, long renders with small frames, scripts that shadow console, and motion blur, audio timing and frame handling.

## Features

- **CLI:** Lambda deploy renders on arm64 by default, and --video-arch x86_64 keeps x86 ([504ec2b30](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/504ec2b307625f790a633184355c07aa3381b8f6), [#6073](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6073)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Push a prebuilt image to ECR without Docker ([0df088926](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0df088926ef94fd42ff772a9990bd3d9f240749d), [#6063](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6063)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Attach the arm64 video image to releases and pin it ([8d562a3d9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8d562a3d918b215f145d84507000ff7a67b68352), [#6070](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6070)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Arm64 video function image from the handler ZIP ([f6cbf87cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f6cbf87cddfda33d805dd37ee23fce9694db84c7), [#6064](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6064)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Run chunks on an optional arm64 image function ([03ed14615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/03ed14615a2988d65ed793f004bcc4446ec89324), [#6065](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6065)).
- **CLI:** Preserve page motion blur off in local renders ([10c724bf5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/10c724bf555f8355199bd89db1a02fc159909dc9), [#6081](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6081)).

## Fixes

- **Producer:** A blank media src is no source instead of the page itself ([c4c1e621d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4c1e621d4280457c4b540df82779540ebe89304), [#6121](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6121)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Keep the arm64 image staging script out of the published package ([401d0655f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/401d0655fb369bf687866f5a032d8a37a5b8b7cf), [#6118](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6118)).
- **Runtime:** A composition script that shadows console no longer breaks the render runtime ([b6de25391](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b6de25391a5e5fbf385c5b17b192b61bc2d39573), [#6119](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6119)).
- **Producer:** Long renders with small frames no longer fail the up-front disk estimate ([aeecf3834](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aeecf38345f0058add246d187289ad0d4ca922e0), [#6117](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6117)).
- **Engine:** Render into a folder whose name holds a percent sign ([69738b7ce](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/69738b7ce411bf63ccbeaaa7db63c0267416f52e), [#6116](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6116)).
- **Lint:** Tell an agent where to move a video nested in a timed wrapper ([d1aeb31bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d1aeb31bf47df81e4f93672124c4f86a5352d0b3), [#6113](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6113)).
- **Core:** Capture blur strobing, backdrop box, glow drop-out and callback motion ([e85f56e86](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e85f56e86c25aaa61fbd93b99498245342f30f14), [#6106](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6106)).
- **Core:** A scene paints no filter output from an HTML layer before its start or after its end ([025549391](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/02554939137a01e72ece2802df5638b85f1a9ba6), [#6097](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6097)).
- **Engine:** Hundreds of effects in one audio group mix in time, and a mix timeout is named ([1accb709f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1accb709ff05e20af42f6657be73ed1e3fb6fd14), [#6101](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6101)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Make webm and mov audio in the separate audio task like mp4 ([f5f884e33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5f884e33d44390fb17d5c8aefe61e55c3dc4264), [#6098](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6098)).
- Preserve motion blur off through cloud render requests ([622527117](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/62252711734aaa42c0f70be9080bd4a2e0aab96a), [#6087](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6087)).
- **CLI:** Preserve video frames when scenes reuse element IDs ([da6b77bd8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/da6b77bd84ad09e57d670f1edebbb3dc9794594a), [#6095](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6095)).
- **Audio:** Fit PCM to video frames before AAC delivery ([9da107aef](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9da107aef54508a5159d0ae3b9c2804c986ef691), [#6089](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6089)).
- **Engine:** Publish video frames only after decoding ([aa4b53533](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa4b53533414e5669caf6a9910c499143bbe0465), [#6092](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6092)).
- **Parsers:** Preserve Unicode offsets when stamping IDs ([1cf4975d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1cf4975d2f6fc58d148561c1e682eb8667bf1c55), [#6079](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6079)).
- Exclude base-marked generated files from comment checks ([36c4a9fd8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36c4a9fd80d50bdc491dad7320bf5360c0417c8c), [#6091](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6091)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Retry a file upload after a dropped connection ([77394fe9e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/77394fe9e52e972123d0868e90f2d56530ef8443), [#6082](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6082)).
- Data-volume multiplies the volume lane in preview and render ([a8ac55dc3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a8ac55dc30b322285d14dc804654b963e83d11b6), [#6068](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6068)).
- **Ci:** Pin and reuse the docs validation CLI ([27b9f6850](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/27b9f6850638bb62e739ae8fc77efa64df444dc5), [#6080](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6080)).
- **Hooks:** Run the checkout's own oxfmt, oxlint and tsc instead of bunx ([b3f586903](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b3f58690357b9c657de7895a7c31be72fcf3959e), [#5751](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5751)).
- **Studio:** The edit-accuracy gate says the shards did not run, not that accuracy fell ([609ff5a7c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/609ff5a7c0133a8985c84ab722dcddb710fc8903), [#6069](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6069)).

## Docs & Examples

- Guide and skill note for opt-in capture motion blur ([4a788583f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4a788583f6ffd311c0093494815faa5f08c498bd), [#6049](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6049)).
- **CLI:** Document every command, and check it in CI ([1b1a576d5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1b1a576d52bcb0bdcef5de67a37024f2224d1a53), [#5938](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5938)).
- Install the Studio app on Linux from the .deb ([29643c7c8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/29643c7c8a3a4085f08f895d56c4b7cc072f2d69), [#5946](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5946)).
- Send docs pageviews to the HyperFrames PostHog project ([32ab255f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32ab255f6148447910ad3423741ec4e13689af0f), [#5948](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5948)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Process tests stop owning old processes that carry a reused parent pid on Windows ([784e1d01d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/784e1d01d94cd28867b1b7f98e6bf00c7946b469), [#6111](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6111)).
- **Studio:** Retain Chrome launch diagnostics ([821003b11](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/821003b112cfed528cabb46b8cb66213e85d28fa), [#6077](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6077)).
- **Windows:** Fail a hung engine-cli test step at its deadline and name the stuck process ([1d0a18c81](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1d0a18c814d3bd53f8752be5a24c7e7c8ace787f), [#6100](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6100)).
- **AWS Lambda:** Pinned native ffmpeg build for an arm64 Lambda image ([bb19f342d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb19f342d3e46dad841afb3563be45e76dfb247c), [#6062](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6062)).
- Mark cloud SDK output as generated ([807803a45](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/807803a4528a1bd27977fff24f0b143041683e00), [#6088](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6088)).
- Help agents find hyperframes on npm and context7 ([3d67fb9d1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3d67fb9d10a864201db9de3214f8cd67fb6fec46), [#5937](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5937)).
- **Studio:** Sample gesture replay from one preview state ([3dd9f5178](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3dd9f517852227061b6cada75b378035385925bd), [#6076](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6076)).

name: v0.8.186
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.186

Released on 2026-10-22.

Capture motion blur now reaches renders and Studio, and it turns itself off, saying why, on pages it cannot blur safely. `hyperframes history` lists its entries even when it cannot write them, and `init --video` frames the project to the clip's shape.

## Features

- **CLI:** Read a whole recording as voice, effect and music lines ([2c1d9d50d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c1d9d50d239d48862578f574c25de216be02746), [#6056](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6056)).
- **CLI:** Tell authors in check why motion blur is off ([4371981b7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4371981b740d92f70e520cfbec34db68a1c93434), [#5992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5992)).
- **Core,engine:** Report why blur is off, and what each render session did ([38f6e01c2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/38f6e01c2be3e29770df4b62f24cf734e385b707), [#5991](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5991)).
- **Core,producer:** Decide blur defects once per timeline, off on routes that cannot host it ([08c185d90](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/08c185d908d657f6142f3cc9ff118b9e29151616), [#5990](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5990)).
- **Core:** Block capture motion blur on html-in-canvas defects ([536346c5d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/536346c5d1e63a8a840bb0a8ba9423ffbab24502), [#5971](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5971)).
- **Core,engine:** Track accelerated canvases before any page script runs ([0865b6f36](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0865b6f36d42a52247bf03de9db3ec9139ed8640), [#5970](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5970)).
- **Producer,studio:** Wire capture motion blur into renders and Studio ([1f8ead7bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1f8ead7bde73a2acb9ff1c5b6327ad0153bd09b8), [#5969](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5969)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** History lists its entries even when this run cannot write the history ([934c88bac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/934c88bac8cf6dc37db07cecf3bd0b58314c9921), [#6061](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6061)).
- **CLI:** Init --video frames the project to the clip's shape, so nothing is cropped ([86b90bb42](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86b90bb424cd3f121419a15e930f17478afc0ea4), [#5984](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5984)).
- **Core:** A clip's volume lane stays smooth in preview while the page is busy ([cfff4493d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cfff4493dfc6ec2edb6f88295009fd89eebfd6c5), [#6057](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6057)).
- **CLI:** A check that runs out of time says which step it was in and how long each took ([2ef60f3f2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ef60f3f26fd51ecf86dc9baa081f7e2b9982a67), [#6060](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6060)).
- **Ci:** Packed consumer installs keep same-day dependency bumps on every Bun release ([2faf660ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2faf660ac1298af0205ebb34028ff45ad5293145), [#6059](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6059)).
- **CLI:** Keep whisper CJK tokens as separate timed words ([3a0caeeb2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3a0caeeb2da8c6428612e67d634b5accaed94fe2), [#6058](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6058)).

## Docs & Examples

- Say background removal can drop objects a person holds ([8d6ceb735](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8d6ceb73598206b2735827d22fcac545f293cd8d), [#6002](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6002)).
- Rename the Workflows nav group to Make a video and drop retired workflow steps ([c4edac305](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c4edac305621f27070e0fa12132fbb6a0ab51004), [#5655](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5655)).

## Internal

- **Skills:** Hide retired skills on ClawHub once the sync has run ([f5873b808](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5873b80892274cb4cfc063f680bbe539c396baf), [#5656](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5656)).
- **Core:** Raise the unpacked size budget for capture motion blur's defect checks ([14e4772b3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/14e4772b36cca08986aa791c49f1e1dcb26eddaa), [#6055](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6055)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.46.1
body:
## Improvements

- Antigravity CLI sessions show plaintext transcripts with model and token usage attached to the matching model replies.

## Bug fixes

- Antigravity sessions parse again on read-only mounts, including read-only Docker volumes.
- Archived Antigravity CLI replies stay intact when the session database cannot be read.
- Repeated prompts remain separate turns in Antigravity CLI sessions. Existing archives are reprocessed to recover missing turns.
- Docker builds no longer fail because a required Claude.ai Chrome extension file is missing.

name: v0.46.0
body:
## New features

- Sync Claude.ai chats through Chrome, including Google sign-in. Run `agentsview chrome setup`, load the printed extension folder at `chrome://extensions`, and restart AgentsView before using Import > Claude.ai.
- Import ChatGPT dot, Codex web, and Codex cloud task chats as searchable sessions with the opt-in `codex-cloud` source. Chats without token counts show OpenAI's plan usage figures. Configure this source on one machine only.
- Record Codex cloud token usage with optional `live_tokens = true`. Capture covers only turns heard live, and connecting can send queued messages. Sessions with incomplete capture show a "partly captured" note.
- Preserve a retired computer's Claude and Codex history with `archive capture` and `archive import --seed`, including stars, pins, names, and original files. Archive commands also extract originals and verify backups. Use a separate data directory for new local sessions.
- Sync remote Linux and macOS machines over SSH without manually installing AgentsView or running a remote daemon. Set `transport = "ssh"` in the remote host configuration. SSH authentication must work without a prompt.
- Browse and search Muse Code sessions, including tool output, child sessions, token usage, and costs.
- Browse and search fx schema 4 sessions with tool output and child sessions. Costs appear when an older fx version saved usage data.
- Find sessions by label, linked pull request, or launcher. Claude Code pull request links appear on session pages and in CLI, API, and MCP results. Linked workers contribute to their launcher's total cost.
- Group model variants in Usage with `[model_aliases]` in `config.toml`. Each variant retains its own pricing before totals combine. Restart AgentsView after editing the groups.
- Narrow Usage totals and charts by selecting an item in the cost breakdown panel. Open `hermes-cron` to compare individual jobs, with renamed jobs and continued runs grouped together.
- Analyze a session's tool effectiveness from its actions menu. Reports mark conclusions as helped, did not help, or unclear and link each conclusion to the calls it cites.
- Compare empty-result, repeat-call, and recovery rates in Tool Usage under project and date filters. Click a nonzero rate to inspect contributing sessions and calls.
- Ask connected assistants about file edits, tool calls, child sessions, Activity reports, tool usage, and cost comparisons through eight new read-only MCP tools. Built-in guide search works offline. `list_sessions` also accepts `include_one_shot: true` for single-prompt sessions.
- Remove an agent's archived history with `agentsview prune --agent <name>`. The filter combines with project and date filters and includes matching sessions in Trash. Prune also deletes matched source files, except shared app-owned stores.
- Sort Activity reports by Session or Model across pages. Cleanup, worktree mapping, and session health tables also support sorting by their data columns.
- Build and push embeddings in one process with `pg push --embed`. Containers accept deployment and embedding settings directly through environment variables, and the container image now requires a bearer token.
- Sign native HTTP reader and raw-sync requests with an independent HMAC key. A separate machine listener enforces signatures, existing authentication, and reader or contributor grants.
- Export repository-scoped activity and usage with reporting schema 5. Known repositories remain selectable when other sessions share their project name. Integrations adopting schema 5 must fetch new project keys and refresh saved digests. Schema 3 remains the default.

## Improvements

- Browse and search the existing archive while a full rebuild runs. Results carry a stale-data warning, and changes pause until the replacement is ready. Failed startup rebuilds retry automatically.
- Keep new local sessions arriving in the archive and UI while a PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or DuckDB push runs.
- Resume interrupted full PostgreSQL and ClickHouse pushes and DuckDB rebuilds. Recent sessions transfer first, and summaries show resumed progress and why a full transfer runs. Passing `--full` discards unfinished progress and starts over.
- Load Usage and Activity faster on large archives. The daemon prepares daily usage totals after sync, and the Usage page starts its model comparison alongside totals.
- Keep quick page reads responsive while slow SQLite analytics run. Large session trees also load faster instead of remaining at "0 SESSIONS" or "LOADING".
- Keep semantic indexing up with long-running sessions by re-embedding only the newest portion of an assistant run. The first build after upgrading re-embeds oversized runs once.
- Transfer less data during HTTP remote sync by leaving unchanged transcripts out of downloads. Updated peers use Zstandard compression, and combined rebuilds prepare several remote hosts at once.
- Push ClickHouse embeddings in batches to reduce transfer time. Large archives also support a configurable `push_batch_size` for session transfers, with higher values using more memory.
- Sync only changed Hermes and Augure Desktop sessions instead of rewriting every session in their shared database. Unchanged remote imports also avoid repeated parsing after a one-time refresh.
- Show Antigravity IDE and local Qoder sessions by their app-saved titles, including existing sessions. Names set in AgentsView take precedence. Qoder renames appear at the next sync.
- Show the recorded starting branch for Codex, TraeX, and Augure Code sessions. Recorded repository identity also survives a missing checkout or changed remote.
- Use provider-reported billed costs for gptme messages when available, including zero. Estimate-only messages retain catalog pricing, and provider-routed model names resolve catalog prices.
- Return stored session usage without waiting for full startup ingestion. Targeted refresh failures retain those totals with a warning.
- Reuse MCP daemon connections to reduce repeated discovery delays.
- Refresh open session lists after imports, uploads, and restores.

## Bug fixes

- Preserve Codex undo history and daily usage as linked continuations instead of letting rollout files replace one another. Older Desktop undo files also link back to their thread. The upgrade rebuilds existing archives and preserves supported saved annotations.
- Keep Codex rollouts under their own thread when a file contains another thread's metadata, preventing one transcript from replacing another.
- Read older Codex rollouts after Codex compresses them to `.jsonl.zst`. Decoding failures leave archived messages intact.
- Import current Mistral Vibe sessions from its unified store, including running turns, tool output, child sessions, and token usage.
- Import DeepSeek Harness v4 and newer TraeX transcripts with their messages, tools, and usage. OpenClaw databases with compressed events also sync without blocking healthy sessions.
- Preserve both Cursor conversations when S3 imports contain the same session ID in different projects.
- Keep archived Claude and iCodeMate CLI tool output after Claude Code deletes its external tool-result files.
- Preserve Hermes and Augure Desktop's shared app database when pruning sessions. Dry-run and deletion summaries report source files left in place.
- Keep message jumps in view while nearby rows finish rendering. Background tabs also release browser connections so new session tabs no longer hang at "Loading messages...".
- Limit SQLite message matches and snippets to conversation text after reparse. Use `--in messages` for dialogue and `--in thinking` for reasoning. Ordinary session search still includes the full transcript.
- Fill MCP content-search pages with eligible older matches instead of excluding active sessions after applying the limit. Restart searches begun before upgrading.
- Accept displayed machine names in filters across the web UI, CLI, API, and MCP. Unknown or ambiguous names return an explanatory error.
- Allow chart palette and zoom changes on read-only servers without editing configuration files by hand.
- Keep archive commands working when unrelated configuration sections are invalid. SSH remote sync also ignores server-only configuration errors.
- Stop repeated Antigravity and Gemini imports caused only by SQLite bookkeeping changes. Recovered file watchers also stop rescanning the entire Claude folder.
- Avoid rewriting unchanged PostgreSQL messages and usage events during metadata-only pushes. Shared PostgreSQL mirrors also stop reporting other machines' unrelated vector sessions as conflicts.
- Prepare ClickHouse usage totals on filesystems that cannot exchange tables, including NFS. Unsupported-exchange errors appear once per server start instead of on every push.
- Produce stable reporting digests when several checkouts or worktrees share a repository.
- Wait through concurrent daemon restarts and preserve host daemon discovery across process namespaces. Auto-starting commands report a held archive lock instead of launching a server that cannot open it.
- Keep Windows daemon commands from marking the entire data directory as changed for backup and sync tools. Stop the daemon before downgrading to 0.45.x or earlier.
- Honor `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` and suppress telemetry in CI and non-release builds. Browser telemetry also waits for the selected server's response before sending further reports.
- Reject compromised eMudhra/emSign certificate chains in HTTPS connections and desktop updates. Linux and Windows desktop builds also update their bundled trust roots.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.49.0
body:
本版新增用量页“今日”小时视图和 Patina 主题，辅助会话支持 Markdown 与流式进度，改过文件的回合不再默认被追问检查，并修复多处内存、卡住和显示问题。

## 新增

- 内置 Patina 主题，雾灰画布、白色浮卡与钢蓝强调色，明暗两套，需要时在设置里手动选择。关联 #14136 by @FuchaZ。
- 用量页多了“今日”范围，单日窗口按小时显示用量、花费和请求。关联 #14176 by @EMEEEEMMMM。

## 变更

- 改过文件的回合不再默认被要求先做检查、复核和签收才能结束；需要时在用户配置里设 `host_verification = "on"`。"交付"预设和 `--fail-on-unverified` 仍会要求。关联 #14154。
- 隐藏图标栏时，侧栏不再有两个打开同一个“远程”设置页的入口；底部重复的“连接与机器”已移除，顶部“运行环境”仍可进入。关联 #14187。
- 自动命名遇到关不掉思考的模型时，会明确提示“模型把输出额度花在思考上”，并建议换一个能关闭思考的命名模型。关联 #14188。
- 隐藏图标栏时，侧栏搜索行与下面的快捷入口之间不再有多余空白；两处小字提示统一使用“·”分隔。关联 #14191。

## 修复

- 配置了 TCP 方式的 DNS 服务器时，健康探测把正常应答的服务器误判为不可用，导致第一个服务器失效后不会切换到下一个。关联 #14044 by @imcreazy。
- 只打开了远程会话窗格时，直接访问本机端口（不带窗格前缀）的请求没有应答，现在会转发给远端内核；本地窗格仍然优先。关联 #14045 by @imcreazy。
- 注入的常驻上下文（技能清单、项目指令、规则、日期）不再因为「已交付」的书签而漏发。关联 #14099 by @chuiwenwei。
- 扩展拒绝、取消、折叠、回退、截断之后，都会按模型真正看到的历史重新判断。关联 #14099 by @chuiwenwei。
- 服务端新建会话（/new）的首个请求现在会带上技能清单、项目指令与日期。关联 #14099 by @chuiwenwei。
- 用量页与 hero 的「实付」现在包含守护评审这些安全审查的花费（此前它们的 token 计入而钱没计入）。关联 #14110 by @chuiwenwei。
- 用量总额现在把"只计了次数和 token、没有金额"的调用（旧版本写入的记录、标题生成）算作未定价，总额标成下限而不是账单。关联 #14112 by @chuiwenwei。
- 标题生成的调用现在会按价目计价，不再只计 token 不计钱。关联 #14112 by @chuiwenwei。
- 旧版 1.x 历史索引不再保留已回退或被覆盖的消息正文，降低启动时的内存压力。关联 #14116。
- `browser_act` 的脚本等待一个永远不会结束的 Promise 时不再无限期卡住（有用户等了十分钟以上）；30 秒后停止脚本，并告诉模型"脚本超时"。关联 #14118 fixed in #14143。
- 最终回答后的工作区观察遇到阻塞 I/O 时，会话不再长时间显示运行中；停止操作会取消观察和证据封存的等待，未完成的观察记录为证据缺口。关联 #13953、#14140 by @SivanCola。
- 上下文压缩超时或取消时，不再因摘要流同时关闭而误报成功或采用未完成的摘要。关联 #14144 by @SivanCola。
- 从微信等应用复制文件粘贴到输入框时，文件会先复制成附件再发送，不再登记原路径，避免来源应用的缓存路径读不到而失败。关联 #14150 by @KHG420。
- 辅助会话面板里的回答现在按 Markdown 显示，加粗、行内代码和列表不再露出原始符号。关联 #14157。
- 辅助问题立即显示提问，流式显示回答文字、阶段和耗时；中断的回答标为未完成，输入保留可重试。关联 #14162 by @lancy69。
- 输入 `/mcp`、`/skills` 时，补全只提供真正会执行的子命令；输入不认识的子命令会明确提示，而不是悄悄显示列表。关联 #14167。
- 宿主发出的「本轮还有未完成事项」的续做提示不再被当成你发的话，不会再变成会话标题、预览或用户轮次。关联 #14170 by @imcreazy。
- 设置里“模型可用的工具”不再显示英文原文；内置工具按界面语言给出一句话说明，被截断的说明也不再在词中间断开。关联 #14175。
- 隐藏图标栏时，侧栏底部的“连接与机器”不再比其他入口更大更粗，和同类入口使用同一字号和字重。关联 #14184。

## 升级须知

- 没有价目的行不再显示成 ¥0，而是把总额标为「未定价调用未计入」的下限。关联 #14110 by @chuiwenwei。
- 超过 64 MiB 安全预算的记录、有效消息正文或 DAG 元数据会被拒绝；原文件保持不变，其他会话仍可索引。关联 #14116。
- 没设过这一项的用户升级后，回合收尾前不再被追问"还欠什么"；项目配置文件仍改不了这一项。关联 #14154。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@FuchaZ、@EMEEEEMMMM、@imcreazy、@chuiwenwei、@SivanCola、@KHG420、@lancy69

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds an hourly Today view to Usage and a Patina theme, renders side-conversation answers as Markdown with streamed progress, stops asking for checks by default after a turn that changed files, and fixes several memory, hang and display problems.

## New

- A built-in Patina theme with a grey canvas, white cards and a steel-blue accent, in light and dark, chosen in Settings when you want it. Refs #14136 by @FuchaZ.
- The Usage page has a Today range, and any one-day window shows usage, spend and requests by the hour. Refs #14176 by @EMEEEEMMMM.

## Changed

- A turn that changed files is no longer held open until a check, review and sign-off exist; set `host_verification = "on"` in your user config for that. Refs #14154.
- With the icon rail hidden, the sidebar no longer has two entries to the same Remote settings page; the duplicate bottom row is gone and "Environments" still opens it. Refs #14187.
- When a model that cannot turn thinking off spends its budget thinking, automatic naming now says so and suggests a naming model that can. Refs #14188.
- With the icon rail hidden, the blank band between the sidebar's search row and the shortcut rows is gone, and both hints use the same "·" separator. Refs #14191.

## Fixed

- The DNS server health probe read a TCP reply as if it had no length prefix and reported a live server as dead, so failover to the next `[network]` server never happened. Refs #14044 by @imcreazy.
- A request made straight to the port with no pane prefix got no answer while only a remote pane was open; it now goes to the far kernel, and a local pane still takes precedence. Refs #14045 by @imcreazy.
- Injected standing context (skills listing, project instructions, rules, the date) can no longer be believed delivered when the model never got it. Refs #14099 by @chuiwenwei.
- A refusal, cancel, fold, rewind or truncation now re-asks the model-visible history instead of a bookmark. Refs #14099 by @chuiwenwei.
- A new session in the served app now starts with the skills listing, project instructions and the date. Refs #14099 by @chuiwenwei.
- The usage page and hero paid total now include the guardian's safety reviews, whose tokens were counted but whose money was not. Refs #14110 by @chuiwenwei.
- The usage total now treats a call that was counted but carries no amount (pre-schema rows, title generation) as unpriced, so the total is a floor rather than a bill. Refs #14112 by @chuiwenwei.
- Title-generation calls are now priced from the rate card instead of counting tokens with no money. Refs #14112 by @chuiwenwei.
- Legacy 1.x indexing retains payload locations, not discarded message bodies. Preflight no longer copies large strings. Refs #14116.
- A `browser_act` script awaiting a promise that never settles no longer holds the call forever; after 30 seconds it is stopped and the model is told it timed out. Refs #14118 fixed in #14143.
- Blocked workspace observation no longer holds a turn after its final answer; Stop cancels observation and seal waits, and incomplete observations remain gaps. Refs #13953, #14140 by @SivanCola.
- Context compaction no longer reports success or accepts an unfinished digest when its summary stream closes at the same time as a timeout or cancellation. Refs #14144 by @SivanCola.
- A file pasted from another application, such as WeChat, is now copied into an attachment instead of being registered by its original path, which could fail to read later. Refs #14150 by @KHG420.
- Answers in the side conversation panel are now drawn as Markdown, so bold, inline code and lists no longer show raw markers. Refs #14157.
- Side questions show your question immediately and stream the answer, phase and elapsed time; interrupted answers are marked incomplete and drafts stay available for retry. Refs #14162 by @lancy69.
- `/mcp` and `/skills` completion now offers only the subcommands that run, and an unrecognised one is reported instead of silently printing the listing. Refs #14167.
- The host's own "work still outstanding" prompt is no longer read back as something you typed, so it stops becoming a session title, a preview line or a user turn. Refs #14170 by @imcreazy.
- The tool list in Settings no longer shows the model-facing English text; built-in tools get a one-line description in the interface language, and a long line is cut cleanly. Refs #14175.
- With the icon rail hidden, the sidebar's "Connections & machines" row is no longer larger and bolder than the other shortcut rows; they share one size and weight. Refs #14184.

## Upgrade notes

- A row with no price no longer shows as zero; the total is marked as a floor with "unpriced calls not included". Refs #14110 by @chuiwenwei.
- Records, retained payloads, and DAG metadata have separate 64 MiB budgets. Refusals preserve files, never use stale checkpoints, and leave healthy sources indexable. Refs #14116.
- If you never set this key, the end-of-turn "still owes" prompts stop after upgrading; a project config cannot change it. Refs #14154.

Thanks to this release's contributors: @FuchaZ, @EMEEEEMMMM, @imcreazy, @chuiwenwei, @SivanCola, @KHG420, @lancy69

name: ctx7@0.8.2
body:
### Patch Changes

- b6ad942: Keep you signed in when several ctx7 commands run at once on an expired session. Each command used to refresh the token on its own, and two refreshes with the same token made the server revoke the whole session. Refreshes now take a lock file next to the credentials file: the first command refreshes and writes the new credentials, and the others wait for it and read them. A running command keeps its lock fresh, so a slow refresh is waited for, while a lock left behind by a crashed command is ignored after ten seconds and no command hangs on it. If the lock cannot be taken, for example on a read-only home directory, the command refreshes as before.

name: v0.21.33
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.33

`0.21.33` is a patch release that recovers team dispatch finalizations from torn journal lines (PR #3893).

This release fixes a critical issue where the `runtime-finalizations.jsonl` journal file could be corrupted after a crash mid-append. When the process crashed while writing a dispatch finalization record, subsequent appends would be lost because the parser couldn't recover from the truncated line. The fix adds tolerant parsing to recover valid commands from corrupted journals and uses newline-isolated appends to protect new entries from torn tails.

## Highlights

- **CRASH RECOVERY: Tolerant parsing of corrupted dispatch finalization journals (#3893):** After a crash mid-append to `runtime-finalizations.jsonl`, the file could contain truncated JSON lines that blocked the entire reconciliation and caused subsequent receipts to be lost. The fix adds `parseRuntimeFinalizationJournal()` which skips malformed lines and recovers all valid dispatch finalization commands, allowing the runtime to gracefully recover from corruption and replay pending operations without data loss.
- **Newline-isolated journal appends (#3893):** New dispatch finalization records are now prepended with a newline separator, ensuring they remain isolable even if a previous append was incomplete. Combined with tolerant parsing, this prevents cascading failures where one corrupted entry blocks recovery of all subsequent entries.
- **Comprehensive test coverage (#3893):** New test suite (`dispatch-finalization-journal.test.ts`) validates recovery from various corruption scenarios: torn lines, null entries, array entries, and unterminated tails. Tests confirm that valid commands are preserved and replayed correctly while malformed lines are safely skipped.

## Compatibility

- No breaking API changes; dispatch recovery improvement only.
- **Team runtime users:** If the runtime crashed during dispatch finalization writes in earlier versions, upgrade to v0.21.33 to recover any pending operations. Recovery is automatic and requires no configuration.
- Existing sessions remain unaffected unless they were interrupted by runtime crashes and had unrecovered dispatch finalizations.
- The fix improves resilience without changing the dispatch API contract.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `fa9b223d8f9fe961a26f048f2132397ccdf7a938` passed CI run 39913485838: 17 checks succeeded, 8 conditional checks skipped, no failures (verified at 07:17Z on 2026-10-23).
- Both macOS Ralplan preflight security jobs PASSED (not cancelled or failed).
- All local gates pass: build, typecheck, lint, and dispatch finalization journal recovery tests.
- All code review findings addressed.
- Ready for merge and release.

name: v0.21.32
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.32

`0.21.32` is a patch release that fixes a v0.21.31 regression in setup scope validation (PR #3890).

This release restores valid macOS and other symlink-heavy systems to working order. On these systems, when HOME or CODEX_HOME crosses a symlink (e.g., `/var` → `/private/var` on macOS), v0.21.31's strict path comparison rejected valid destinations as "outside managed scope," breaking setup for 113+ macOS test runs. The fix canonicalizes all scope paths before comparison, allowing setup to work correctly across symlink boundaries while maintaining security.

## Highlights

- **REGRESSION FIX: Symlink canonicalization in scope validation (#3890):** The v0.21.31 symlink guard used path string comparison that failed when HOME or CODEX_HOME contains symlinks (common on macOS where `/var → /private/var`). The fix canonicalizes all paths to their real destinations before comparing, allowing valid scope entries on symlink-heavy systems while maintaining the v0.21.31 security improvement. Setup now correctly validates scope boundaries across OS symlinks in scope ancestors.
- **Correct project root validation scope (#3890):** Directories like `.codex` and OMX_ROOT are now validated against their own root boundaries, not the workspace root. This prevents rejecting valid configurations where project-scope .codex lives in a nested subdirectory or OMX_ROOT points to a managed third-party path.
- **Legacy skill receipt migration (#3890):** The setup command now detects and migrates legacy user-scope skill receipts from pre-0.21 locations during upgrade, preventing loss of historical skill data.
- **Windows cross-drive backup path handling (#3890):** Backup paths that cross drive boundaries on Windows are now sanitized through the unified helper, preventing path traversal issues and invalid references.
- **Dangling symlink detection (#3890):** Before canonicalizing paths, the setup command now detects dangling symlinks and refuses them with clear error messages, preventing silent failures and ambiguous path resolution.

## Compatibility

- No breaking API changes; setup security improvement only.
- **macOS users:** If you hit "outside managed scope" errors on v0.21.31, update to v0.21.32 to restore setup functionality.
- Existing sessions remain unaffected unless they were broken by v0.21.31's regression.
- Setup now succeeds on symlink-heavy systems while maintaining symlink-destination refusal (the v0.21.31 behavior) for managed paths.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `44d33163fd5512a143eaedb6f2377a816f819a2a` passed CI run 39878502256: 17 checks succeeded, 8 conditional checks skipped, no failures (verified at 01:17Z on 2026-10-23).
- Both macOS Ralplan preflight security jobs PASSED (not cancelled or failed).

name: v0.21.31
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.31

`0.21.31` is a patch release for setup symlink safety and dispatch reliability improvements (14 files, +761/−79; PR #3881 and #3886).

## Highlights

- **Setup symlink destination refusal (#3881):** The `omx setup` command now detects and rejects symlinked managed destinations (including dangling links) before reading, backing up, or writing. This prevents scenarios where a committed `.gitignore` or prompt path symlink could cause `ensureBackup` to overwrite files outside the repository. The check validates every path component without following symlinks, not just the leaf destination, preventing writes through symlinked ancestor directories. The check is applied to all write paths: `.gitignore`, native agent TOMLs and manifest, HUD config, and skill receipt. This is a behavioral change: setup now fails closed on symlinked managed destinations.

- **Dispatch message reliability (#3886):** Fixed mailbox dispatch enqueue-barrier sequencing to guarantee message ordering under concurrent worker acknowledgements. Dispatch now re-validates monitor state inside the barrier to prevent stale wakes, and correctly acknowledges notifications to prevent repeated reschedules. The fix applies to all dispatch paths that interact with the mailbox monitor.

## Compatibility

- No breaking API changes; setup security and dispatch reliability improvements only.
- Existing sessions remain unaffected unless they have symlinked managed destinations (which will now be rejected with a clear error message and workarounds).
- Setup now fails fast on symlinked destinations instead of silently writing through them.
- Dispatch reliability is transparent to callers; no changes needed to session code.

## Known Gaps (tracked for v0.21.32)

Three setup.ts findings require path canonicalization improvements:

- **P1: CODEX_HOME authority root:** When user-scope setup uses a supported `CODEX_HOME` outside the OS home directory, validation incorrectly anchors to `homedir()` instead of the configured Codex home. This is fixed in PR #3890 (fix/setup-scope-realpath-0.21.32).

- **P2: Symlinked parent paths:** When an ancestor of the scope root is a symlink, the destination is not canonicalized before comparison, causing rejection in valid symlinked-parent environments. This is fixed in PR #3890.

- **P2: OMX_ROOT override validation:** When `OMX_ROOT` or `OMX_STATE_ROOT` points outside the repository, runtime directory validation incorrectly uses `projectRoot` as the authority. This is fixed in PR #3890.

## Validation

- Pinned release candidate passed latest-per-name release CI with all required checks green (verified at 19:57Z on 2026-10-22).
- Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.
- All Codex code review findings documented above for v0.21.32 follow-up.

body: - Updated dependencies to address recent software ecosystem vulnerabilities. ([#66023](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66023), [#65963](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65963))

## New Features

- Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)
- Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)
- Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)
- Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)
- Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
- The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

## Bug Fixes

- Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
- Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)
- Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
- CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
- Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)
- Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)

## Chores

- Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)
- Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

name: v5.1.44
body:
**The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.21-3: long 1M-context conversations stop re-writing their cached prefix, Anthropic subscription context is counted once, and "No credential slots available" no longer locks every account out ([#10965](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10965)).** When context reduction trims a long conversation on a 1M window, the reduced prefix now stays identical and keeps its cache checkpoint, so each step writes only what changed. Anthropic subscription turns with internal SDK re-requests no longer double the context percentage or start compaction early, and a configured compaction model now summarizes while your session provider is healthy, overflow recovery included. The subscription lane is the only layer that picks its accounts, so one revoked or briefly rate-limited account no longer blocks the rest until you log in again. Every turn end says what happens next, a turn-end report names the hold your queued message released, the trailing "Anything else? (optional)" card is gone from clients without native questions, and moving a session between machines runs through one implementation. Forced recovery after a context overflow no longer picks the same compaction cut again when an invisible entry leads the session; an overflow still never moves a task to its next fallback model.

**A session's first prompt no longer freezes a shared host while it reads what changed in memory ([#10728](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10728)).** A session resumed a few hours after its last turn read the memory commits since then with one `git diff-tree` process per commit, all started at once. On a busy memory repository that was thousands of processes, and starting them blocked every session on the same host for 28 s with one session and 142 s with seven, while the finished ones piled up unreaped. The range is now read with one `git log`; the same notices come out, the longest block with seven sessions fell to 16 s, and the host's memory footprint during prompts fell from a median of 1,258 MB to 813 MB. ([#10726](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10726))

**Prompts stop freezing a shared host after every memory commit ([#10731](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10731)).** Recall skips memory notes the conversation already mentions, and it rechecked the last 200 messages against every note again after each memory commit, one note at a time. On a 7,500-note memory that took 1 to 1.7 s per session per prompt, with every session on the host waiting. Earlier answers now carry over and only notes the commit added are checked, so a recheck takes about 6 ms and the first check about 0.2 s; with seven sessions and a commit every 20 s, the host's blocked time fell from 185 s to 28 s over four and a half minutes. The notes skipped are unchanged. ([#10729](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10729))

**A relaunch's first prompt no longer recompiles your memory.** The compiled memory block and its size estimate are now saved by commit inside the memory repository's `.git` folder, never committed or synced, and read back on the next launch. On a 6,862-note memory this cut the memory step of a prompt from a median of about 178 ms to about 52 ms in the desktop app. A block built after a git read failed is used once and never saved. ([#10674](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10674))


**Anonymous usage stats now count how many accounts you have linked per provider.** `session_started` reports, per provider kind, how many accounts the engine lists for it (the same list the app's account list shows: signed-in accounts and environment-variable slots), used or not, as capped counts only, never an account name, email, token or value ([#10919](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10919)).

**The desktop app and `omo login` can share one device on a machine.** A new hidden `omo account` command (`show`, `adopt`, `token`, `export`, `forget`) lets the desktop use the same OS-keychain sign-in the CLI writes, so a machine counts as one device for memory sync and only one process ever refreshes its tokens. Secrets pass only on stdin and stdout, a refused renewal (exit 5) names the service's refusal code so the desktop can say why the sign-in ended, and a locked OS keychain is reported as its own outcome (exit 7) instead of a generic failure. On Linux, where a locked Secret Service collection reads as empty, the default collection's lock state is read over D-Bus before any secret call (libsecret would otherwise ask the keyring to show an unlock prompt), a locked collection is reported (exit 7) instead of read, and when that check cannot answer (no `gdbus` on a minimal install, no Secret Service on the bus, a slow bus) the CLI prints one notice and uses libsecret directly as before, so login never depends on `gdbus` ([#10658](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10658)).

**Memory sync can join a new device.** `omo sync enable` turns memory sync on for the device and, if the account already syncs, asks a device that already syncs to approve it. `omo sync approve` on that device answers the request. Both screens show the same 6-digit code, and the new device is admitted only after the person confirms the codes match. A relay that swaps keys produces a different code and is refused. `omo sync recover` points to passkey recovery in the desktop app. ([#10625](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10625), [#10634](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10634))

**A task started on a task host now records its own session id from the start ([#10885](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10885)).** Before, the id stayed empty for every hosted task, so anything that looks up a parent task from a child's session, such as the desktop app's task tree or the cleanup when a task is cancelled, missed hosted tasks. The id was already in the host's answer when the session opened; it is now kept.

**Anonymous usage stats now count the providers you signed into, not only the ones you configured.** `session_started` counted only the providers in `models.json`, so a user who just signed into a subscription or added an API key showed zero providers. It now counts both, reports `signed_in_provider_count` and `configured_provider_count` separately, and still sends only the names of providers OmO ships (anything else is `custom`), never an account, key or credential ([#10889](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10889)).

**A memory write recovers on its own after a crashed writer on Linux too.** When a memory writer was killed mid-commit, the next write is meant to clear the git lock it left behind once the writer is proven dead. On Linux that check read other processes through `/proc`, and on a normal systemd login (or an SSH session, or a CI runner) some of the user's own processes cannot be read, so the lock was always kept and every write failed until `/memory unlock`. Memory's git commands now hold a kernel file lock that their git processes inherit, and the cleanup asks the kernel whether any of them is still running. A live writer's lock is still never removed. ([#10604](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10604))

**Resuming a session no longer asks git whether the commit it is pinned to still exists when that commit is the current HEAD.** That saves up to two git processes on the first prompt after a resume. ([#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707), [#10854](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10854))

**Each prompt reads your memory's git HEAD once instead of up to three times.** The memory nudge, the soul notice and the session pin now share one read, which saves up to two git processes on every prompt. ([#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707), [#10855](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10855))

**In a Bun project, `lsp_diagnostics` on a TypeScript directory typechecks it with `bun check`.** A project with `bun.lock`, `bun.lockb`, `bunfig.toml` or a `bun@` `packageManager` gets the errors `bun check` reports, which are the same errors as tsc 7. When the installed bun has a linter, `bun lint` diagnostics are added. For a project that formats with prettier, the Senpi formatter runs `bun format --write` instead of the prettier binary, but only once bun has proven it rewrites a file in place. Each command is used only after `bun <command> --help` succeeds in an empty directory, never when the project's own script of that name would run instead, and a probe that times out is retried rather than remembered as absent. Every other project keeps the language-server path unchanged ([#10840](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10840), [#10843](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10843)).

**A task-store admission no longer freezes the session while the disk is slow to flush ([#10867](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10867), [#10868](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10868)).** Registering a session's task store before a task host starts now does its durable write (fsync, rename, directory fsync) off the event loop, so a loaded Linux disk delays only that registration instead of every timer, socket and prompt of the process.

**Memory no longer turns the assistant's own suggestion into "the user decided".** Memory is now reference only: a remembered decision or approval counts only when its receipt quotes the user, and every memory write and extracted fact records who it came from (`source: user`, `agent` or `inferred`). A `user` receipt is kept only when the user's whole reply, sent right after the assistant's proposal, is a short explicit approval such as "yes", "ok", "delete it", "네" or "지워줘"; the receipt names the proposal it approved. Anything else, including a hedge, a question, an image-only message in between, or an older "ok", is stored as an agent suggestion, so the agent asks again instead of acting on memory. Thanks to @wuhaoyujerry for the report. ([#10488](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10488), [#10498](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10498))

**Cancelling a task now also stops the tasks it started ([#10824](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10824)).** Before, the cancelled task's session suspended its running children as if it could be resumed later, so they kept running tools on the task host with nobody able to collect them. A cancelled, lost or killed task now cancels its children when its session shuts down, and the same rule applies one level down. A live task's quit or reload still keeps its children so they can be collected on resume.

**A task start is no longer refused when the model check can't finish on a busy machine.** Before a task child starts, OmO checks that its model is available by listing models in a fresh CLI with a 20-second budget; on a heavily loaded machine that listing ran out of time twice and the start failed with `catalog_probe_timed_out`, even for a valid model. A check that times out now lets the start go ahead and is logged, a model list from the last 30 minutes is noted in that log, and a child that truly can't use its model fails as `model_unavailable` with its own error ([#10863](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10863), [#10865](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10865)).

**Internal: telemetry-core can host OpenTelemetry and send product events as OTLP with a write-ahead spool.** A new `@oh-my-opencode/telemetry-core/otlp` entry point provides minimal OpenTelemetry logger and tracer providers, a spool that writes every event to disk before it is queued (so a crash loses nothing already emitted), and an OTLP/HTTP sender with retries, a 5 MB spool cap, a dropped-events counter and a 2 s shutdown cap. Every telemetry opt-out, plus `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true`, still applies: nothing is written while telemetry is off, and an opt-out deletes every file the spool itself created in earlier runs, never anything else in its directory, skips (and reports) any spool-named entry that is not a regular file of the current user, reports each of its own files it could not delete by error code as an incomplete opt-out, and refuses to touch a spool directory that is a symlink, belongs to another user, or resolves outside the root its caller names. A collector that accepts a request and never answers cannot stall sending, because each request times out after 10 s. Nothing uses it yet; the switch arrives with a later `telemetry.sink` setting. The entry point reads the opt-outs and consent before importing anything, so a run with telemetry off loads no OpenTelemetry or protobuf code. Every event goes through the projection the caller passes (the schema artifact's per-event allowlist; there is no default), spans keep only the attributes the span allowlist names, and no free-text slot (a LogRecord body or severity text, an unlisted span name) reaches the wire. ([#10272](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10272), [#10273](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10273))

**OmO Native records whether people use the handoff hint.** When senpi shows its handoff hint (the line that offers a fresh session once a large session's cache has expired, code-yeongyu/senpi#3230), OmO Native sends one `handoff_hint` event per shown, accepted and dismissed hint. It carries the context size, the two prices the hint displayed and whether the session was on a subscription, under the usual telemetry consent and opt-outs. The handoff brief, session text and file paths never leave the machine ([#10607](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10607)).

**Sends waiting for a child now say queued, not delivered.** A workflow node send and an eval-handle send that was only accepted locally report `queued`, even when the child's run ends before the host receives the message, instead of claiming delivery. The input-identity regression waits for the host's input events before checking the sequence ([#10318](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10318), [#10668](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10668)).

**OmO sessions prewarm the prompt cache again, and anything that blocks it is named.** Since v5.1.17 every OmO session skipped senpi's prompt-cache prewarm, because the gateway, onboarding and task-host `before_agent_start` handlers were not registered as preview-safe; they now are, and a preview changes no state (no onboarding claim, no gateway store, no host launch). An unsafe `before_agent_start` registration warns immediately, including one added after startup; a recorded skipped prewarm is reported once per session at the next lifecycle event, with its reason and the blocking components and source locations. Gateway preview lookup errors now pass the prompt through and warn once instead of throwing. ([#10356](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10356), [#10372](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10372))


### Fixed

- While a delegated task hands off to its next fallback model, its row, `task_output` and completion notice no longer claim it ran on a model nothing has run on yet: the record keeps the last model a child was seen running until the new one reports, and the parent-model note reads "switching to" during the handoff and "was never confirmed running on" if the task ends before a child is seen on it ([#10797](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10797)). ([#10807](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10807))

name: v5.1.42
body:
**Memory sync checks each new keyring entry without re-reading the chain before it.** The client now uses the shared receiver's incremental entry point (omo-service #600, re-vendored), and the receiver moves along with the verified chain state. Appending one entry to a 1,000-entry chain used to hand the receiver all 1,006 entries again; it now hands it one, at any chain length. What the receiver refuses is unchanged, including a replayed or lower-seq entry. ([#10694](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10694), fixes [#10655](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10655))

**The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.21-2: idle task hosts exit again, reopened sessions stop spending quota, and sessions share their prompt cache ([#10893](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10893)).** A monitor watch no longer keeps every task shard host on the machine running, so idle hosts exit as designed. Reopening an unattended session no longer spends quota on goals or background events until you send input or choose Resume. Responses prompt-cache keys follow the model, instructions and tool schemas instead of the session, so new sessions and task children with the same prefix reuse one cache. A goal waiting on a subscription limit retries at the provider's reset time instead of hammering the spent account. On Windows, input sent while a turn is running no longer gets stuck or races through the whole fallback chain. Switching a long conversation to a smaller-context model while the current one is at its limit now applies at the next message, saving an API key over an OAuth login (or the reverse) replaces the credential instead of storing one that is never used, a busy command monitor is no longer muted after 200 lines a day, and every assistant reply records its timing (time to first token and generation rate).

**OmO records when an answer says "tests pass" or "done" with nothing in the session behind it.** When a turn's final answer says tests pass, a build or typecheck is clean, a feature already exists, or the work is done, OmO checks the session for a check that passed after the last code edit, and records in the session whether the claim is backed. It starts in shadow mode: nothing is shown to you or the agent and no turn is blocked or continued, because on a week of our own sessions most flags were still false positives. Setting the `omo-senpi-claim-receipt-nudge` flag turns on a short note under a flagged answer (once per message you send) and passes the flagged claims to a gate reviewer spawned afterwards. ([#10785](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10785))

**`omo doctor --models` shows which model every task category and agent runs, and `exclude_models` keeps a model out of all of them ([#10763](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10763)).** The new doctor view prints, per category and agent, the model a spawn runs first, the retry chain in order, and each rung's source (built-in, omo.json, or the category an agent borrows) with why it does or does not run: excluded, no login, or not reached. It reads the same resolvers spawns use, and `--json` gives the same view to scripts. The new top-level `exclude_models` list (`provider/model`, a bare model id, or a `*` pattern such as `"claude-fable-*"`) is honored by category and agent chains, memory children (the session model they would inherit included), the main session's model profile, explicit task pins, and task children respawned or resumed on a recorded model, including their recorded fallback chains. Before, no setting could stop a builtin rung from running; only logging out of its provider did (#10759).

**Geeky becomes Obsessive.** The two GPT lanes' display names are now Obsessive · Normal and Obsessive · Heavy, with one-line descriptions to match and a shared caution, NOT RECOMMENDED FOR WRITING OR EVERYDAY WORK., that the session-start notice renders in bold; the `geeky-normal` and `geeky-heavy` ids and the `family` they report stay unchanged, so a saved `model_profile`, a picker choice or a user overlay keeps resolving exactly as before. A `model_profiles` entry may set its own `caution` string, and one that replaces a builtin inherits its caution when it does not. ([#10608](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10608), [#10590](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10590))

**Obsessive · Normal leads with GPT-6 Astra at medium.** The `geeky-normal` model profile resolves GPT-6 Astra at medium on every GPT provider first, with its GPT-6.1 Sol Fast, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-5.6 Sol rungs kept as availability fallbacks; Obsessive · Heavy keeps Astra at high. ([#10608](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10608), [#10590](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10590))

**Memory sync can verify and seal real batches.** The sync engine now has a production verifier and sealer: each row another device appended is checked against this device's verified copy of the account chain, then opened with the epoch key the device holds, and only that memory's own notes reach it. Outgoing batches are encrypted, signed and linked the same way. Nothing uses this yet; the device sign-in that opens a session comes next. ([#10625](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10625), [#10627](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10627))

**A signed-in device now reaches memory sync.** Memory sync used to stay idle on every device, because nothing gave it the device's sign-in. It now reads the device `omo login` signed in, and the key pair that device registered, then opens the account's sync for that memory. A device that is signed in but has not joined the account's memory yet says so instead of reporting no sign-in. When the device signs out or is removed, sync closes and goes back to idle. ([#10625](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10625), [#10630](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10630))

**A subtask whose category has no model left now finishes on the model your session runs.** When every model in a delegated task's category is out (its usage limit is spent or its provider is not signed in), the task continues on your session's model in the same conversation, so tool calls it already finished are not run again. Before, it stopped with a usage-limit error even though your own model was working. The task's row, `task_output` and the completion notice say which model it ran on and why, for example `parent-model:usage limit, resets 3:20am`, and name any tool call the limit cut off, which never ran. Categories with a model that still works route exactly as before, and a session model on the same spent account still ends with the old error. Until the engine can limit this to spent or signed-out models, a task whose category models all fail for another reason, such as an overload, also continues on your session's model and says so ([#10750](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10750), [#10772](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10772)).

**Git worktrees of one repository can share the main checkout's memory.** Set `memory.auto_identity: "git"` (for example in `~/.omo/omo.jsonc`, so worktrees created outside the main checkout see it) and every linked worktree, including the ones Orca creates per agent, reads and writes the main checkout's memory instead of starting empty. The main checkout keeps its existing memory, sessions that are already bound keep theirs, and the default `"path"` leaves behavior unchanged. ([#9659](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9659), [#10047](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10047))

name: CC Switch v4.0.19
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.19

本版本新增对 Kimi Code 的支持，它是 CC Switch 管理的第 12 个应用。**Kimi Code 的命令行版和桌面版共用同一份配置，所以 CC Switch 的支持对两者都适用。**Kimi Code 的多个供应商可以同时写进它的配置，在 CC Switch 里添加、移除、设为默认；MCP、Skills、提示词同步给 Kimi Code，会话可以浏览和恢复，用量从会话日志导入；「应用」页可以安装、升级、卸载 Kimi Code。Kimi 编程套餐也能在授权中心登录，可以添加多个账号，每个账号显示昵称和额度。用量统计页重新排了版：时间、应用、供应商和模型放在同一行，选中的指标同时决定趋势图和热力图，明细表改成带数量的页签，请求日志可以选每页条数。另外修复了聚合模式下从第三方 GPT 切到其他模型后 Codex 一直报 `unsupported call: exec`、在 Linux/WSL 上从终端启动时打开「关于」页整个应用卡死、给 Codex 选模型后图片输入被关掉、Claude Code 的 VS Code 扩展经 Responses 上游时显示 `redacted_thinking` 报错、macOS 上 Claude 订阅额度读错钥匙串条目、Antigravity 额度缺少 Gemini 一组、Hermes 装在 WSL 里时控制台在 Windows 上启动、按 Esc 一次关掉所有叠起来的面板等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.19-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.19-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Kimi Code

Kimi Code（命令是 `kimi`）现在是一个独立的应用，有自己的供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词、会话和用量（[#8687](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8687)）。配置在 `~/.kimi-code/config.toml`，设置了 `KIMI_CODE_HOME` 时用它指定的目录。

> **💡 命令行版和桌面版都适用。** Kimi Code 的命令行版和桌面版共用 `~/.kimi-code` 里的同一份配置和登录，在 CC Switch 里添加的供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词和官方账号，两个版本都能直接用。

- **供应商可以同时启用。** 和 OpenCode 一样，多个供应商可以同时写进 Kimi Code 的配置，在 Kimi Code 里用 `/model` 选择。「可添加」的卡片点「添加」写进配置，不改默认模型；已添加的卡片可以「移除」，「设为默认」在卡片的更多菜单里。Kimi Code 正在用作默认模型或子代理模型的供应商不能移除，会提示你先在 Kimi Code 里换掉。只改 CC Switch 管的那些供应商和模型，其他配置原样保留。
- **添加供应商。** 预设和其他应用一样按「模型厂商」「第三方平台」「云服务商」「本地」分组，另有「账号登录」分组用来登录 Kimi 官方账号。「获取模型列表」后选中的模型会自动填上上下文窗口、思考和图片输入；每个模型一行，可以填显示名称（Kimi Code 的 `/model` 里显示它）。「始终思考」「按需加载工具」旁边有「?」说明；请求头挪进了「高级选项」。
- **MCP、Skills、提示词。** MCP 支持 stdio、HTTP 和 SSE；Skills 不会覆盖 Kimi Code 自己目录里的同名技能。
- **会话和用量。** 可以浏览和恢复 Kimi Code 的会话；用量从会话日志导入，包括输入、输出、缓存、首字时间和耗时。
- **「应用」页管理 Kimi Code。** 用官方安装程序安装，可以升级和卸载。
- Kimi Code 不经过本地路由，也没有聚合模式。

### Kimi 官方账号

在授权中心可以「登录 Kimi」（添加供应商里选「Kimi Code 官方登录」也会带你过去），选国内版或海外版，在浏览器里完成授权后自动添加官方模型（[#8710](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8710)、[#8726](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8726)）。

- **多个账号。** 第一个账号用 Kimi Code 自己的登录位置；之后添加的每个账号都有自己的凭据、供应商和模型，在 Kimi Code 的模型列表里显示为「Kimi 订阅 <昵称>」。在授权中心点「使用此账号」，或在卡片更多菜单里选「设为默认」，就把 Kimi Code 的默认模型换成这个号的。官方卡片不能在供应商页编辑或删除，要在授权中心管理。
- **昵称和额度。** 每个账号和官方卡片都显示昵称和额度。快过期的登录会在后台续期，和 Kimi Code 自己用同一把锁，不会和它抢；Windows 上只读取额度，不续期。
- **重新登录和删除。** 重新登录同一个号会更新原来的那一份，不会多出一个；删除单独添加的账号会一起删掉它的供应商、模型、凭据和卡片，正在使用时不能删。Kimi Code 自己登着的号只会从列表里移出，CC Switch 不会替它退出登录。
- 在 Kimi Code 里已经登录的号会自动出现在授权中心。

## 改进

**用量统计页重新排版**（[#8711](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8711)）。

- 页面右上角只留一个同步按钮（显示上次同步时间）和一个设置按钮，数据来源、显示和价格设置都在设置里。请求日志显示哪些列，改在请求日志页签右侧的「请求日志的列」菜单里选。
- 时间、应用、供应商和模型放在同一行，供应商和模型合成一个两级菜单。
- 概览里点选一个指标，趋势图和热力图就显示它；输入、输出、缓存读写四项 Token 可以展开成第二行。
- 明细页签去掉了「设置」，剩下「请求日志」「供应商」「模型」三个，标签上带数量；表格按内容宽度排列，太宽时左右滚动，时间和应用两列固定在左边。
- 请求日志可以选每页 10、20 或 50 条，默认 20 条，会记住你的选择。没有数据的格子显示「—」。

**OpenCode、OpenClaw 的「设为默认」挪进更多菜单。** 以前已添加卡片上的星形图标不好认，也看不出有没有选中。现在在卡片的更多菜单里，有多个模型的供应商可以从子菜单里选默认模型。OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi Code 的默认供应商改用和「使用中」一样的蓝色标出。

**Pi 的供应商标识始终显示。** 用预设添加时也会显示并预填，可以修改；和别的 Pi 卡片重复时，输入框下方会提示，不能保存。以前要到保存时才报错。

**MCP 服务器显示自定义的显示名称**（[#8692](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8692)）。设置了显示名称的服务器，列表和删除确认框里都显示它，标识写在旁边。

**会话页的项目分组标题整行都能点击展开和收起**（[#8709](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8709)）。

**预设：** 新增 BuyToken、V-API。

## 修复

- **聚合模式下从第三方 GPT 切到 DeepSeek、Kimi 等模型后，Codex 每一轮都报 `unsupported call: exec`**（[#8676](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8676)）。第三方 GPT 和其他模型调用命令行工具的方式不同，以前切换时 Codex 不会先压缩历史，新模型照抄了历史里它不支持的调用。现在在这两类模型之间切换时，Codex 会先用原来的模型压缩一次；同一类模型之间切换照旧不压缩。
- **在 Linux 或 WSL 上从终端启动 CC Switch，打开「设置 → 关于」整个应用卡死**（[#3241](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3241)）。查询工具版本的命令占住了终端，被系统暂停。现在这个查询不再占用终端，最多等 10 秒。
- **给 Codex 选了获取到的模型后，图片输入被关掉**（[#8682](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8682)）。查到的资料说模型只支持文字时，以前会写成「只支持文字」，Codex 就拒绝图片，表单里也没有办法改回来。现在只在资料说支持图片时才填这一项，其他情况交给 Codex 默认的判断。
- **选了中转站的某些模型后，填进来的是别家的参数**（[#8765](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8765)）。以 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 为例，models.dev 上没有 DeepSeek 自己的这个条目，以前会借用另一家托管的微调版本，填进去的是「只支持文字」和 262K 的上下文窗口，只有实际窗口的四分之一。现在查不到原厂条目时不再借用别家托管的条目，这几项留空。
- **Claude Code 的 VS Code 扩展经 OpenAI Responses 上游时，工具调用前显示 `Unsupported content type: redacted_thinking`**（[#8691](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8691)）。只有加密内容的思考以前转成了扩展不认识的格式，现在改成和 Anthropic 一样的空思考块；发回上游的请求不变。只在最后才给出的思考摘要也会补上。
- **macOS 上 Claude 订阅额度查询失败**（[#8764](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8764)、[#8762](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8762)）。钥匙串里有好几条同名条目时，可能读到一条只存了 MCP 登录信息的旧条目。现在先按当前用户的账号找，找不到可用的登录再回到原来的方式。
- **macOS 上 Antigravity 官方卡的额度只有 Claude/GPT，没有 Gemini。** Google 只把 Gemini 额度返回给较新版本的 agy，现在查询时会带上本机 agy 的版本。
- **Windows 上刷新 Antigravity 额度、获取模型列表时弹出黑色命令行窗口**（[#8700](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8700)）。
- **Windows 上 Hermes 装在 WSL 里时，Web UI 未启动时点「打开终端并启动」，启动的是 Windows 上的 Hermes**（[#8689](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8689)）。Hermes 配置目录指向 WSL 路径时，现在会在那个 WSL 发行版里运行 `hermes dashboard`。
- **Codex 请求带 `session-id` 或 `thread-id` 头时，路由认不出会话**（[#8718](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8718)）。
- **阿里云百炼、千问 Token Plan 的 Anthropic 地址获取不到模型列表**（[#8755](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8755)）。
- **OpenCode Zen、Go 的供应商从 models.dev 补不全模型参数。** models.dev 换了这两家的地址，现在旧地址也能对上，`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 等模型又能自动填上参数。
- **叠着打开好几个全屏面板时，按一次 Esc 全部关掉。** 现在只关最上面那个。
- **一个深链接还在导入时又来了第二个，第一个导入完成后会把第二个的确认框关掉**（[#8696](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8696)）。
- **用量页的「近 7 天」「近 14 天」「近 30 天」在夏令时切换前后多算或少算一天**（[#8719](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8719)）。
- **请求日志停在后几页时，总数变少后表格变空、回不去。** 现在会退回最后一页。
- **「应用」页没安装的工具下面多出一行英文的「not installed」。**
- **按下「高级选项」时文字跳动。**

## 升级说明

**数据库版本从 21 升到 22**，为 MCP 和 Skills 增加 Kimi Code 的开关。升级前会自动备份数据库；升级后再退回旧版本，旧版本会提示数据库版本过新，打不开。

- Kimi Code 默认显示在侧栏，不用的话可以在「应用」页关掉「在侧栏显示 Kimi Code」。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo（Kimi Code 支持、Kimi 官方账号）、@94mashiro（用量统计页重新排版）、@AkimioJR（MCP 显示名称）、@minimote（会话分组标题）、@StrengW（Codex 会话请求头）、@clarkchen（百炼 Token Plan 模型列表）、@allenxu09（Claude 订阅钥匙串条目）的贡献。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@kuqitt、@GuanyuZ、@Amiyadesi、@cgheaven、@xu-song、@zhangyang-crazy-one、@m11y、@chen-985211、@1074854980、@xiaoshidefeng、@seth-shi、@Konsn666、@HyacinthHaru、@Komikawayi、@aofee、@yan9651688、@yulv706、@harrison-pan、@szupzj18、@yk4642d97f-boop、@czhmartinez、@ntdatt812、@YongmaoLuo、@moeacgx、@zichen0116、@John1Tang、@OriyukiAkari、@Piao-2024、@jintonglu6688、@hhhkkk666-dot、@mikkley、@SailingLoong、@fanxing-6、@songzhibin97、@kZime、@RoiexLee、@wangwenjier、@magicapple123、@jzcangshu、@lyfuci、@ggbdpq、@alfchao、@wrenfix、@NestorRay。
